Class SimulationSettings

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.simulation.SimulationSettings
public final class SimulationSettings extends Object
The settings of a simulation model in Bio7: a custom view ("Settings") with a control for each field with the annotation Param and a button for each method with the annotation Action (the same controls as the HTML export, below the headings of their groups). A change sets the field of the running model (live) or, with restart = true, sets it and calls the setup.

A model can show an own panel, e.g., a Composite designed with the WindowBuilder: Simulation.settings(Composite) creates it. The widgets of its fields are bound to the model by their names (see bind(Object, Simulation)).

    bind(Object panel, Simulation model)
    Binds the widgets of a panel (e.g., a Composite designed with the WindowBuilder) to the model by the names of the fields of the panel: a Scale or Slider with the name of a Param field: the range of the Param (min, max, step), else the value of the selection a Spinner: the value (with its digits), a Text: the value as text a check Button: a boolean Param, a Combo: a String Param (the options of the Param if the Combo has no items) a Label with the name of a Param and "Value" (e.g., feedValue): shows the value a push Button with the name of an Action method: calls the method; the names setup and export: the setup and the HTML export Called automatically for the panel of Simulation.settings(Composite).

    • bind

      public static int bind(Object panel, Simulation model)
      Binds the widgets of a panel (e.g., a Composite designed with the WindowBuilder) to the model by the names of the fields of the panel:
      • a Scale or Slider with the name of a Param field: the range of the Param (min, max, step), else the value of the selection
      • a Spinner: the value (with its digits), a Text: the value as text
      • a check Button: a boolean Param, a Combo: a String Param (the options of the Param if the Combo has no items)
      • a Label with the name of a Param and "Value" (e.g., feedValue): shows the value
      • a push Button with the name of an Action method: calls the method; the names setup and export: the setup and the HTML export
      Called automatically for the panel of Simulation.settings(Composite).
      Parameters:
      panel - the object with the widgets as fields
      model - the simulation model
      Returns:
      the number of the bound widgets
